rules.title: Exemption from Local Rent Control for Newly Constructed Multiple Dwellings
rules.requirement: Newly constructed multiple dwellings are exempt from any local rent control ordinances for a period of 30 years following the completion of construction.

coverage.summary: Applies to newly constructed multiple dwellings.

rules.quoted_span: Under the Newly Constructed Multiple Dwellings Law ( N.J.S.A. 2A:42 -84.5), newly constructed multiple dwellings shall be exempt from any local rent control ordinances for a period of 30 years following completion of construction of the building.

rules.title: Maximum Security Deposit Amount
rules.requirement: A landlord may not charge a security deposit greater than one and one-half times one month's rent.

coverage.summary: Applies to most residential rental properties, excluding owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings unless requested by the tenant under specific provisions.
coverage.owner_condition: Owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings are initially exempt.

rules.quoted_span: The maximum-security deposit to be collected by the landlord cannot be more than one and one-half times one month’s rent ( N.J.S.A. 46:8-21.2 ).

rules.title: Security Deposit Return Deadline
rules.requirement: Within 30 days after the termination of a tenancy, a landlord must return the security deposit, plus interest earned less lawful deductions, to the tenant.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential tenancies governed by the Security Deposit Law.

rules.quoted_span: Within 30 days after the termination of a tenancy, a landlord must return the security deposit, plus interest earned less deductions, to the tenant ( N.J.S.A. 46:8-21.1).

rules.title: New Jersey Law Against Discrimination - Housing Protections
rules.requirement: Landlords are prohibited from discriminating in housing accommodations based on race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, marital status, civil union status, domestic partnership status, familial status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, mental and physical disability, nationality, or source of lawful income.

coverage.summary: Applies to all landlord-tenant relationships with specific exemptions for two-family owner-occupied dwellings, rooms in owner- or resident-occupied single homes, and single-sex facilities.
coverage.owner_condition: Excludes two-family owner-occupied dwellings and rooms in an owner- or resident-occupied single home.

rules.exemptions: Two-family owner-occupied dwellings, rooms in an owner or resident-occupied single home, and residences planned exclusively for and occupied by one sex.
rules.quoted_span: The New Jersey Law Against Discrimination (LAD), N.J.S.A. 10:5-12(g) to -(h), prohibits discrimination when selling or renting property and requires equal treatment in the sale or rental of housing regardless of race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, marital status, civil union status, domestic partnership status, familial status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, mental and physical disability, nationality, or source of lawful income.
